description: This file defines the WaypointProgressTracker class used for managing waypoint navigation and progress tracking in a Unity-based route following system.

classes.name: WaypointProgressTracker
classes.description: A Unity MonoBehaviour class that tracks progress along a waypoint circuit, manages lookahead targeting, and provides progress information for AI or other systems.

methods.name: Start
methods.description: Initializes the tracker, creating a target transform if none is assigned, and resets progress.

methods.name: Reset
methods.description: Resets progress variables and sets the target position and rotation based on the current circuit waypoint.

methods.name: Update
methods.description: Updates the target position and progress along the route based on the current progress style (smooth or point-to-point).

methods.name: OnDrawGizmos
methods.description: Draws visual debugging aids in the Unity editor to show the route and target direction.
